environment.network: none (every mutation verify runs with a refusing opener)

failure_modes_match: exact: mutation-report.json has no top-level failure_modes field; it must be absent or equal this (empty) list
failure_modes_note: A mutation report has no top-level failure_modes field, so none are expected. The escaped mutant verified as PASS and carries no failure mode.
must_mention_match: case-sensitive substring of mutation-report.md written to --output

additional_expectations.counts_note: The counts follow from the 20 operators of science-gate 0.1.0 (ARCHITECTURE.md section 10) and from which of them find a target in this tree. The blind-spot set, exactly [M04_duplicate_row], is the part of this entry that is independent of the operator set.
must_not: a skipped or not-applicable operator counted as detected

supplementary_verify.purpose: Shows the accepting baseline directly and produces the run receipt kept in receipts/ (mutate writes no receipt).

field_sources.status, reason, exit_code: mutation-report.json top level (exit_code also the process exit code)

intended_by: the entry author, from ARCHITECTURE.md section 10, before the recorded run

recorded_run.note: The recorded run reproduced every expected field. The fixture was revised once before the recorded run, so that the duplicated record is not cited by numeric_agreement and the escaped mutant verifies as PASS; see entry.json unresolved_cases. The expected outcome itself was not changed.

does_not_prove: Reproducing these results shows conformance on this declared synthetic fixture only.
It does not show scientific validity of anything, that every blind spot is found, or fitness for any use.
